rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a matching collection or a complete package of related items.

example.english: This set of tea ware is a gift for newlyweds.
example.traditional: 呢一套茶具係送畀新婚夫婦嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 jat1 tou3 caa4 geoi6 hai6 sung3 bei2 san1 fan1 fu1 fu5 ge3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for putting something somewhere or arranging things, including setting the table.

example.english: We set the table before eating.
example.traditional: 我哋食飯前先擺好張枱。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6 cin4 sin1 baai2 hou2 zoeng1 ci4

rows.note: Use this for adjusting a device or control, especially an alarm, clock, or timer.

example.english: Remember to set the alarm before you go to sleep.
example.traditional: 你記住校好個鬧鐘先瞓呀。
example.jyutping: nei5 gei3 zyu6 gaau3 hou2 go3 naau6 zung1 sin1 fan3 aa3

rows.note: Use this for the sun going down or, by extension, the close of the day.

example.english: We need to get home before the sun has set.
example.traditional: 日落之前我哋要趕返屋企。
example.jyutping: jat6 lok6 zi1 cin4 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gon2 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this when deciding or fixing an amount, rate, date, or other matter.

example.english: We’ll set the delivery date now.
example.traditional: 我哋而家定低個交貨日期先。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 deng6 dai1 go3 gaau1 fo3 jat6 kei4 sin1

rows.note: Use this technical noun for a mathematical set whose members are treated as an unordered collection.

example.traditional: 呢個集合入面有三個數字。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 zaap6 hap6 jap6 min6 jau5 saam1 go3 sou3 zi6
